## Natural walkthrough films

Launch Studio now turns a fresh website recording into a chronological walkthrough film with editorial motion, page-aware chapter labels, an original full-length score, and automatically composed narration.

- Render continuous real browser footage for up to 58 seconds.
- Use Kokoro locally or connect a custom TTS pipeline and its existing owner-approved voice profile.
- Save a finished MP4 and poster without exporting script, transcript, captions, or storyboard files.
- Choose landscape, vertical, or square video and polished, cinematic, or playful direction.

See the [voice pipeline setup](https://github.com/KunjShah95/walkcast/blob/main/docs/launch/voice-pipeline.md) for the custom endpoint contract.
